Country of origin in the tile data: 43 of the 49 regular listings India, the 6 shearlings Turkey. Mostly sheep, lamb, goat and cow leather or suede.

US terms and conditions, last updated August 2026 (https://www.allsaints.com/us/help/contact-us/terms-and-conditions/terms-and-conditions.html): seller is All Saints Retail Limited, registered in England and Wales, registered office London E1 6NN; Standard Shipping 5-7 business days 'Free', 3-Day Air $14.95, Next Business Day $24.95; returns within 28 days of receipt, 'free US returns service'; Final Sale items not returnable; no shipping to APO/FPO or PO boxes.
Size guide (https://www.allsaints.com/us/sizeguide.html): womenswear XS (2-4) to L, US 00 to 12 (bust 30-41 in); menswear XS to XXXL, chest 34-46 in.
Store locator (https://www.allsaints.com/us/stores/) lists US stores in 16 states, including California, New York, Illinois, Texas and Florida.

Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AllSaints): founded 1994 by Stuart Trevor and Kait Bolongaro; HQ London; owned by Lion Capital (chairman Lyndon Lea, 'owner via his Lion Capital firm'); 281 stores in 27 countries and regions.
